SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA

MARISOL OYELARAN-DIAZ,
Plaintiff,
vs.
PACIFIC RIDGE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, INC., and DOES 1 through 20, inclusive,
Defendants.

Case No. 26CV038119

PLAINTIFF'S REQUESTS FOR ADMISSION, SET ONE, TO DEFENDANT PACIFIC RIDGE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, INC.

PROPOUNDING PARTY: Plaintiff MARISOL OYELARAN-DIAZ
RESPONDING PARTY: Defendant PACIFIC RIDGE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, INC.
SET NUMBER: ONE

Pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure section 2033.010, Plaintiff requests that Defendant admit the truth of the following matters within thirty (30) days of service.

DEFINITIONS

"YOU" and "YOUR" mean Defendant Pacific Ridge Property Management, Inc. and its officers, employees, and agents.

"THE PROPERTY" means the residential building at 1440 Fruitvale Avenue, Oakland, California.

"THE INCIDENT" means the ceiling collapse in Unit 3B of THE PROPERTY on November 14, 2025.

INSTRUCTIONS

1. Respond to each request separately. Each request seeks the admission of a single fact, opinion, or the genuineness of a single document.

2. A written response is due within thirty (30) days of service. A matter is deemed admitted if no timely written answer or objection is served.

3. Admit or deny each matter. If YOU cannot truthfully admit or deny, state that a reasonable inquiry was made and that the information known or readily obtainable is insufficient to enable YOU to admit or deny.

4. If YOU object to a request, state the objection with specificity and respond to the remainder.

REQUESTS FOR ADMISSION

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 1: Admit that YOU managed THE PROPERTY on November 14, 2025.

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 2: Admit that YOU received a written complaint about water intrusion in Unit 3B before THE INCIDENT.

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 3: Admit that YOU did not inspect the ceiling of Unit 3B between January 1, 2025 and THE INCIDENT.

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 4: Admit that no permit was obtained for the roof repair performed at THE PROPERTY in August 2025.

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 5: Admit that Plaintiff was a tenant of Unit 3B on the date of THE INCIDENT.

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 6: Admit that THE INCIDENT caused Plaintiff to vacate Unit 3B.

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 7: Admit that the document attached as Exhibit A is a genuine copy of the maintenance log YOU kept for THE PROPERTY in 2025.

REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 8: Admit that YOU have no written record of any response to the complaint identified in Request for Admission No. 2.
